name: sample_liquidation_strategies
description: Synthetic liquidation strategy configuration for V1 LMT calibration scenarios.

strategies.name: cash_then_liquid_assets
strategies.description: Uses cash above the configured minimum buffer first, then eligible liquid assets.

strategies.name: portfolio_profile_pro_rata
strategies.description: Sells eligible non-cash assets proportionally to preserve the portfolio liquidity profile.

strategies.name: partial_cash_then_pro_rata
strategies.description: Uses part of cash above the configured buffer, then sells eligible non-cash assets proportionally.

strategies.name: balanced_custom_weights
strategies.description: Allocates liquidation needs across ETFs, listed equities, and reverse repos using configured weights.
